Durban Poison has also been used to create numerous modern hybrids, including Girl Scout Cookies and Cherry Pie. Terpene Profile Terpinolene leads the terpene profile with sweet, herbal, and piney notes that create the distinctive anise-like aroma and provide uplifting, focusing effects. Ocimene adds floral, citrus, and herbal complexity with energizing properties that enhance mental clarity. Myrcene provides subtle earthy balance without overwhelming the strain's inherently energizing character. The combination produces a sweet, spicy aroma reminiscent of anise, pine, and fresh herbs with a hint of citrus zest. Growing Process Durban Poison THCA is cultivated indoors under full-spectrum LED lighting in small batches where each plant receives individual attention.
